stem: [洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法]新成立的一家小型数字银行最近任命了一位高级反洗钱报告官(MLRO),该行集团首席合规官已指示其建立一套有效的反洗钱交易监控系统,以识别异常和可疑交易.在数字银行选择和实施反洗钱交易监控系统时,有哪些重要的考虑因素？(选择两项.)

options.A: 供应商是否已记录针对系统设计和数据集成架构的适当内部控制措施
options.B: 系统生成的警报的审查、调查和报告详情的权限及用户访问设置是否与其他银行所采用的设置相匹配
options.C: 监测系统是否与银行的规模、业务、复杂程度和风险相适应
options.D: 监测系统是否能够进行配置,以使银行能够对交易活动执行趋势分析,并识别出异常的业务关系和交易

stem_en: The recently appointed senior money laundering reporting officer (MLRO) at a newly opened small digital bank has been instructed by the group chief compliance officer to implement an effective AML transaction monitoring system that can identify unusual and suspicious transactions. What are important considerations for the project to select and implement the AML transaction monitoring system at the digital bank? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Whether the vendor has documented appropriate internal controls for designing system and data integration schema.
options_en.B: Whether the permissions and user access settings for reviewing, investigating, and reporting details of alerts generated by the system match the settings used by other banks.
options_en.C: Whether the monitoring system is proportionate to the bank's size, business, complexity, and risk.
options_en.D: Whether the monitoring system can be configured to enable the bank to perform trend analysis of transaction activity and identify unusual business relationships and transactions.
